verdict.rationale: The Agent SDK's own MCP documentation says agents can connect to MCP servers to query databases and integrate with APIs like Slack and GitHub without custom tool implementations. Servers can run as local processes, over HTTP, or in-process within the SDK application, which covers the story's plug-in-servers-for-tools capability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that MCP server integration works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: With MCP, your agent can query databases, integrate with APIs like Slack and GitHub, and connect to other services without writing custom tool implementations.
MCP servers can run as local processes, connect over HTTP, or execute directly within your SDK application.
Using the SDK's in-process MCP server, you can give Claude access to databases, external APIs, domain-specific logic, or any other capability your application needs.
